objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document in DHC VISION for policies, guidelines and documents, including content, metadata, versions, release, distribution and archiving.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the release of the main document and subject to versioning.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual user of the DHC VISION system.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person assigned authorizations or distribution for documents.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for system roles, reader assignment, distribution and authorizations.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned to documents to assign read and change rights to users/persons.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document without affecting the content or version history of the document.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created for invalidating a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for revalidating invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document for distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of acknowledgement requested from persons and users of assigned user groups.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document visible in corresponding login language after release.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be automatically linked.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in DHC VISION by attachment of a new information object and selection of document type/template.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Document metadata, authorization assignments, workflow participants, and other properties are maintained.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Document content is edited using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: A document is saved.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: A saved document is automatically converted to PDF and displayed on the web.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: A pure object cover is created.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: An external file or document is uploaded to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: A new document is generated on an object cover based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is modified.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is added to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is modified.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving or archived with the next released document version.

evts.name: assign_authorization_group
evts.description: An authorization group is assigned specifically to a document.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Reader authorizations are assigned via user group assignment.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: A person is assigned as author of a document.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: A person is assigned as co-author of a document.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: A person is assigned as reviewer of a document.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: A person is assigned as releaser of a document.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: The approval process is initiated by one of the co-authors or by the author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers complete the review step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: An assigned releaser completes the release step and the document is finally released.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_review_or_release
evts.description: A rejection during review or release cancels the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: revise_released_document
evts.description: A valid released document is revised and a new editing version is automatically created.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author-rights employee creates a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation and creates a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents editing of an assigned change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A completed change proposal is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: A request for validity extension is processed with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared, the request is deleted, and the document remains valid.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: process_request_for_aks
evts.description: The request for AKS is processed in a workflow.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: A document and its attachments are declared invalid and archived.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After archive duration expires, documents are physically deleted.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created and the corresponding document is selected.

evts.name: process_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The request for reactivation workflow is processed by the request creator.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is revalidated and a new version is created.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are assigned to a document's distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Assigned users and users of assigned user groups receive e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and users of assigned user groups are requested by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient actively confirms acknowledgement in a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: display_dashboard
evts.description: Dashboards are filled and documents are listed based on distribution groups.

evts.name: run_report
evts.description: A role-specific evaluation report is run for documents or acknowledgements.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Translated version is checked with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Translated language version is released and visible in corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: For each document in a multi-client system, clients in which the document is visible or not are specified.

evts.name: create_local_addition_document
evts.description: A new document is created in a client to describe a local addition or extension.

o2o.description: One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new document objects.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
A document can be supplemented with additional information.
A document can be supplemented with attachments that are associated with the document version.
Authorization groups can be assigned specifically to documents.
Users can be assigned to user groups.
Reader and distribution user groups can be assigned to documents.
Persons can be assigned as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, or distribution recipients for documents.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A corresponding invalidated document is selected for reactivation in a request for reactivation.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
User groups can be assigned to a distribution list.
Persons can be assigned to a distribution list.
Acknowledgements relate to the current version of a document distributed for acknowledgement.
A language version is a translated version of a released document.
For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients can be specified.
Documents can be linked to Master data.
Documents can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents can reference other documents, including local addition documents referencing original documents.
